$comment: Engine-boundary hits that are legitimate, one entry per path (a trailing slash covers a directory). "terms" lists the phrases excused there (omit it to excuse every term, rarely right); "rule" names a non-term rule. Every entry needs a reason. An entry marked "until" is debt: it names the work that removes it, and the gate lists it on every run. An entry that stops matching anything fails the gate, so delete it the moment its hits are gone.
